title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-l9ck: transcript_4 parameter `ciphertext_3` should be `plaintext_3` per EDHOC spec
description: The transcript_4 function parameter is named `ciphertext_3` but per EDHOC RFC 9528 Section 4.1.2, TH_4 = H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3). Both call sites (production and test) now correctly pass plaintext, but the parameter name is misleading and contradicts the spec. Rename to `plaintext_3`.
